messages:
Lena M: Dropping a few notes from today's design review — main focus: stacktrace interactions and the export/share flows in Trace Viewer. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc — please skim and call out any blockers.
Omar (Design): Nice work. Two areas I want to call out: 1) collapsed stack frames need a clearer affordance (chevron is subtle at small densities), 2) copy action for a single frame should be inline and not buried in the kebab menu.
Ravi (Eng): Inline copy is fine. Implementation caveats: we need to ensure keyboard focus lands on the copy button when a frame is selected; avoid trapping focus inside the frame container. Also copying large stack frames should chunk so the UI doesn't freeze.
Priya - PM: For exports, product wants: a) quick export (CSV summary of spans) b) full export (ndjson/json with spans + annotations) c) selected-frames export (for sharing snippets). Which should be primary action?
Omar (Design): Primary should be "Quick export" with a secondary dropdown for the others. Quick export keeps the number of clicks down for day-to-day debugging. Full export can be in the menu and should show estimated size.
Lena M: Accessibility: screen reader behavior for exported content is important. If we show an in-app preview of a large trace, that can be noisy. Better to announce "Export started" with a live-region and provide link to the download when ready.
Ravi (Eng): Agree. We'll implement a polite live region and a background job for heavy exports. For large traces we should stream to the client via chunked response and show a progress indicator; also allow cancel. Backend will emit progress events over websocket or SSE.
ux-bot: Accessibility reminder: avoid modals that trap focus without a visible close button. ARIA: dialog role + aria-modal, ensure aria-describedby references helpful text.
Priya - PM: Privacy/compliance question: Dedicated & Private customers sometimes disallow raw trace dumps. We need an enterprise flag that disables full-export and switches full-export to redacted mode (remove PII and IPs).
Ravi (Eng): We'll add feature flags. Also for permalink sharing: generate ephemeral tokens for Private orgs, expiry 1 hour. For hosted customers we can use stable permalinks but mask internal IDs.
Omar (Design): Microcopy: for the export modal use verbs like "Download summary" and "Download full trace (may be large)". For the permalink tooltip: "Copy permalink (expires in 1h)" when the org is private.
Lena M: Keyboard nav: suggestions: Enter to open row, E to expand/collapse stack, C to copy corr-id, Shift+D to start download. We must publish a conflict matrix. Keep the simple actions reachable via single keystroke.
Ravi (Eng): Note: single-letter shortcuts conflict with global shortcuts (e.g. C for compose). We'll scope them to when trace row is focused and show the key in the tooltip and in the help overlay.
Priya - PM: Acceptance criteria for the ticket: 1) inline frame copy + toast with sr-only text 2) export menu with quick/summary/full + size estimate + cancelable progress 3) permalink flow with ephemeral tokens for Private orgs + copy action 4) keyboard shortcuts documented + combo conflicts resolved 5) a11y checklist attached.
Lena M: I'll update the mocks to show high-contrast chevrons, visible focus ring on frame hover/focus, and an inline copy icon with sr-only text. Also adding a compact mode toggle for dense views so users with long sessions can switch.
infra-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/trace-viewer-export-v3.png
Omar (Design): One last UX nit: export menu keyboard focus currently moves behind the trace title visually. Ensure tab order is Title -> Actions -> Export menu -> Next row.
Ravi (Eng): Will make sure. Also will add an API warning header for big exports: "This export may take several minutes and incur usage charges".
Priya - PM: Thanks team. Lena/Omar, please push updated assets by EOD Thu and I'll slot a dev handoff for Fri morning.
Lena M: Roger that — will include the accessibility acceptance checklist in the PR description.
